source_caption:
The “I love… I love… I love you” scene in Pride & Prejudice works because Darcy is usually so controlled, but here he completely loses his composure. Matthew Macfadyen turns the confession into something breathless and almost painful, like the words are escaping before he can protect himself from them.

Pride & Prejudice (2005), directed by Joe Wright, starring Keira Knightley, Matthew Macfadyen, Rosamund Pike. A lush and emotionally charged adaptation of Jane Austen’s classic romance, capturing pride, longing, and quiet transformation through glances, misunderstandings, and unforgettable chemistry.

source_details.title: Pride & Prejudice
source_details.synopsis: Pride & Prejudice is a 2005 period romance film directed by Joe Wright, in his feature directorial debut, based on the 1813 novel by Jane Austen. The film features five sisters from an English family of landed gentry as they deal with issues of marriage, morality, and misconceptions. Keira Knightley stars as Elizabeth Bennet, while Matthew Macfadyen plays Mr Darcy, who falls in love with her. Screenwriter Deborah Moggach initially attempted to make her script as faithful to the novel as possible, writing from Elizabeth's perspective while preserving much of the original dialogue. Wright encouraged greater deviation from the text, including changing the Bennet family dynamics. Wright and Mogg
